description: This file defines classes and functions for generating a workcenter load report in an Odoo module, including date computations, data fetching, and PDF report creation.

classes.name: external_pdf
classes.description: A class for rendering external PDF content, inheriting from 'render'.

classes.name: report_custom
classes.description: Main class for generating a custom workcenter load report, including date calculations and PDF creation.

methods.name: _compute_dates
methods.description: Calculates date ranges based on the specified time unit ('month', 'week', or 'day') between start and stop dates.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Generates the report PDF by querying production data, preparing charts, and assembling the PDF document.

methods.name: _empty_graph
methods.description: Creates a placeholder graph indicating no production orders.
